entries.en: Everybody hang on!
I... I can't believe Kaidan didn't make it. How could we just leave him down there?
Thanks, Commander. Things got pretty hot down there. You saved my life.
It's a distress call, a message sent out across the Prothean Empire. A warning against the Reapers, but the warning came too late.
Saren will have his entire fleet orbiting Ilos. You will never make it down to the surface without reinforcements. You must alert the Council. We need a fleet to-- ohhh...
I am sorry. The joining is... exhausting. I should go to the medical bay and lie down for a moment.
Your role in our communion is passive. I am the one who must submerge myself in your mind. Drown myself in your thoughts. It is more difficult than it looks.
The human subconscious instinctively resists the joining, Commander. A strong personality like yours makes it even harder. I just need some time to recover.
That will not be necessary. I just need some rest. Somewhere quiet.
Tell me. Your visions -- have they changed at all? Do you know where the Conduit is now?
That is unfortunate. I am afraid our only choice is to go to Feros. Maybe we will find what we need there.
But how are we going to find him? Or the Conduit?
But how are we going to find him? Or the Conduit?
But how are we going to find him? Or the Conduit?
What about that beacon? The one in the base? Did it give you another vision? Did it show you where the Conduit is?
What about that beacon? The one in the base? Did it give you another vision? Did it show you where the Conduit is?
Both our lives. I don't know how you did it, Commander. The Alliance'll come up with a whole new medal for what you pulled off here.
If they don't court-martial you. You endangered the entire mission. Why didn't you just leave one of us behind?
We might have tried, Commander. But I don't think either one of us could have pulled this off.
Anyone else, I'd say they got lucky.
Kaidan's right. Nobody else could make a stunt like that work. Put anyone else in charge and someone gets left behind. Or the mission fails.
I... I can't believe Ash didn't make it. How could we just leave her down there?
But why me? Why not her?
I know. And I am grateful. But Ash died because of me. Because of us.
I'm sorry, Commander. You saved my life. I'm grateful for that. But if I'd done my job-- We should have been able to save her.
But if I'd done my job, you wouldn't have had to make that call.
Yes, sir. I'm-- We'll get it done.
It should have been me, Commander. You know that.
I know. And I'm grateful. But Kaidan died because of me. Because of us.
I-- I'm sorry, Commander. You saved my life. I'm grateful for that. But it should have be me. Alenko was a superior officer. I would have gladly stayed behind.
Yes, sir. I'm-- We'll get it done.
Commander? Excuse me for interrupting. But I have an idea. I think the beacon you found in Saren's base was similar to the one you found on Eden Prime.
It may have filled in the missing pieces of your vision. I might be able to help you put all those pieces together.
I understand your reluctance, Commander. But the visions are already there. I only want to help you make sense of them. It may be the only way to stop Saren.
Relax, Commander. Embrace eternity!
Incredible. I... I never thought the images would be so... intense. I need a moment to collect myself.
Say what you want, Williams. If you were calling the shots, you'd have done the same. Alenko would've, too.
The mission was never in danger. I had it all under control.
No one gets left behind. Not while I'm in charge.
This mission isn't over yet. We still have to find the Conduit before Saren does.
I won't accept failure. This mission is too important. Saren's still looking for the Conduit. But we're going to find it first!
Williams knew the risks going in. She gave her life to save the rest of us.
We had to leave her behind. Saren has to be stopped. At any cost.
There was no time. I couldn't save you both. The bomb was about to go off.
I'm sorry, Kaidan. I'd never leave you behind. I couldn't. You know that.
Lieutenant Alenko, I am your commanding officer! I did what I had to do. Don't question my orders!
It wasn't your call, Alenko. I had to choose. I chose you.
It wasn't your fault. It wasn't my fault. The only one to blame here is Saren.
Get it together, soldier! Ash's blood is on Saren's hands. And when we find that son-of-a-bitch, I'll make him pay.
Williams is dead. We can't change that. But if we don't stop Saren, her sacrifice was made in vain.
Alenko knew the risks going in. He gave his life to save the rest of us.
We had to leave him behind. Saren has to be stopped. At any cost.
There was no time. I couldn't save you both. The bomb was about to go off.
I'm sorry, Ash. I'd never leave you behind. I couldn't. You know that.
Chief Williams, I am your commanding officer! I did what I had to do. Don't question my orders!
It wasn't your call, Williams. I had to choose. I chose you.
It wasn't your fault. It wasn't my fault. The only one to blame here is Saren.
Get it together, soldier! Kaidan's blood is on Saren's hands. And when we find that son-of-a-bitch, I'll make him pay.
Alenko's dead. We can't change that. But if we don't stop Saren, his sacrifice was made in vain.
You want to join our minds again, don't you? Okay. Go ahead.
Nobody is messing with my head anymore! I'm sick of dealing with these visions!
Looks like I don't have a choice.
It's worth a shot.
We don't have a moment. Snap out of it and tell me what you saw!
Did the vision make any sense to you?
What about the Conduit?
Are you sure it was the joining? I feel fine.
Dr. Chakwas should take a look at you.
We're done here. Dismissed.
The vision changed. But it's still not clear.
I'll let Joker know where we're headed. Dismissed.
It's still not clear. And we've only got one lead left: the Atremis Tau cluster. Crew... dismissed!
Something's different, but I still can't figure it out. And we're down to our last lead. Time to head for the Artemis Tau cluster. Crew... dismissed!
He was a good soldier.
The mission can't fail!
It was you or him.
I'd never leave you.
Don't question me!
It was my decision.
Don't blame yourself.
We will avenge him!
We have to go on.
I'm willing to try.
Forget it!
Do it.
Fine.
Hurry up!
What did you see?
Anything else?
That's it?
It didn't tire me out.
Are you okay?
Go ahead.
Something's different.
I'm not sure.
Let's go.
I'm not sure.
The vision changed.
You wouldn't have.
I knew what I was doing.
Not an option.
Saren's still out there.
We can't fail!
She was a good soldier.
The mission can't fail!
It was you or her.
I'd never leave you.
Don't question me!
It was my decision.
Don't blame yourself.
We will avenge her!
We have to go on.
Commander, there's a comm buoy nearby. I can link us in if you want to report back to the Citadel Council. You know, to warn them about Sovereign.
Patching it through.
Aye, aye, Commander. Sovereign will be sitting on the Citadel's roof before those bastards listen to us.
Set the link up, Joker. They need to know.
They're not going to believe any of this. Not without proof. We'd just be wasting our time.
I'll tell them.
Why bother?
There were other images. Locations. Places I recognized from my research... Ilos! The Conduit is on Ilos!
That is why Saren needed to find the Mu Relay! It is the only way to get to Ilos.
The Mu Relay links to dozens of systems and hundreds of worlds. How was I to know Ilos was the one we wanted?
Without the Cipher, the images in your visions were never clear. Only now do I recognize them as landmarks from Ilos.
Forget it. The Mu Relay's inside the Terminus Systems. Alliance ships are not welcome there. Neither are Spectres.
I've never heard that name before.
Never heard of it.
I'm not familiar with that planet.
I am not surprised. Ilos is in a region of space accessible only through the Mu Relay. But the Mu Relay was lost thousands of years ago. Nobody knows where it is.
I recognized some of the landmarks from photos and vids I'd seen during my research. I know of Ilos. I just do not know where it is.
Its original coordinates would place it deep inside the Terminus Systems. Unfortunately, a star in one of the nearby systems went nova roughly four thousand years ago.
The shockwave sent the relay trillions of kilometers off course. Then the dust and radiation from the exploding star engulfed that entire region in a dense nebula cloud.
Finding any object in space is difficult. Finding the Mu Relay inside a nebula cloud is virtually impossible. It would take decades.
I am afraid so. Unless you somehow find the coordinates for the Mu Relay. Then it would be possible to-- ohhh!
How come you never told us about Ilos before?
We need to get to Ilos!
The Conduit's on Ilos. That's where Saren is heading. I'll be waiting for him when he gets there!
If nobody's ever been there, how did you recognize Ilos from my visions?
How do you lose a mass relay?
Are you saying it's hopeless?
Do it.
Go ahead.
This is important.
You never mentioned this.
Let's go!
Time's short!
We have to hurry!
Let's go!
Time's short!
We'll be careful.
That won't stop me!
We have no choice.
Ilos
Mu Relay
So we can't find it?
No.
Good idea.
Time's wasting.
No.
No.
Do it.
That's not fair.
Aye, aye, Commander.
Aye, aye, Shepard.
Ash, how far are you going to drive yourself? Are you trying to be a martyr? To redeem your grandfather's honor?
The hell it isn't. I don't want a marine with a death wish covering my back. Get over it.
What the public and the military did to him was unfair. But I don't want to lose you because of it.
What the public and the military did to him was unfair. But I don't want to lose a good soldier over it.
Don't sacrifice yourself.
I don't want to lose you.
We need you.
Bull.
But it's true.
But it's true.
Don't blame yourself.
Don't blame yourself.
Yes, ma'am. I'm-- We'll get it done.
Yes, ma'am. I'm-- We'll get it done.
